data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Rise as US-Iran Hold Off Strikes: Analyst Says 'Very Likely' Bottom is in, Bets Most on This Coin
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies lifted late on Sunday alongside stock futures as investors weighed the pause in hostilities between the U.S. and Iran.
